items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember who played with Manuel Perez in those years? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, Big Jim, Little Jim, Johnny Deve, Alfred Williams.

ctx.x: During that time. Sam Morgan, he played at Mise en Blanche in the stores, then he used to play on the truck, which I took part of it later on in the years, you know? Played on the truck, advertised for Mise en Blanche, and it.
Do you remember who played with Manuel Perez in those years? I don't know why I just know them. Who played with Sam Morgan then?
Well, Big Jim, Little Jim, Johnny Deve, Alfred Williams. Well they didn't have, Oilo Fusje, Andrew Morgan. How about eight men?
